reviewer: Codex independent child agent demo_audio_languages; source-read-only review
kind: Bounded correctness review; not a security audit, hardware qualification or exhaustive all-argument proof

findings.title: Source audio and rebased video used different timestamp origins
findings.before: With video.start_time=0.5 and audio.start_time=0, the decoder rebased first picture to zero while source audio retained the container origin. A pulse at1.35s remained at1.35s instead of0.85s relative to the displayed picture; coarse time bases and non-frame-aligned seeks also require the actual decoded origin.
findings.resolution: The source-audio decoder uses copyts/start_at_zero and a one-frame showinfo side branch before setpts/fps, computes the actual first video PTS using its time base, and trims audio from that observed origin. Rendering retains the already-read first frame. The renderer and validation records retain source_audio_origin; missing/out-of-bounds origin is refused. Diagnostics are drained and bounded.
findings.verification: qa/demo-audio/integration-final.log: positive video start at clip0/0.25/1.0, fine/coarse timebase trim, decoded picture/audio anchors; eight integration tests passed across13exports.

findings.title: Missing AAC encoder still allowed enabling source audio in the desktop
findings.source_anchor: qml/DemoWorkspace.qml demoSourceAudio enabled binding and following Caption; tests/demo_workspace_test.cpp missing_aac_keeps_silent_exports_available_and_allows_muting_existing_scenes
findings.resolution: A false capabilities.audio.source_available prevents enabling source sound, explains the local AAC requirement, and still permits switching an already-enabled scene to muted. Muted exports and PNG previews retain the general render path. The added explanation is translated in all50catalogs.

checked_contracts.topic: Old version1 scenes and request identity
checked_contracts.conclusion: Missing audio defaults to muted; new scenes explicitly emit muted. Scene format version stays1. Muted render identity omits only the new audio field from struct-order JSON, preserving the legacy digest rather than reordering via Value.

Only muted/source modes are accepted; source mode requires source.has_audio. Partial update admits audio, verifies revision and immutable media; the queued request freezes its scene revision and copied local source.
General ready still means the silent H.264 path is available. AAC availability is separate, and source-audio export refuses missing AAC before starting. PNG preview does not require AAC.

Audio uses the observed first-picture origin, keeps subsequent source gaps, and mixes with a finite silence bed to ceil(duration*fps)/fps. Short or already-ended audio cannot shorten video; no -shortest truncation is introduced.

Validation enforces expected H.264 dimensions/frame count/FPS/duration, requested audio presence, single AAC48k stereo stream at zero within bounded duration tolerance, and full video plus audio decode. Renderer silent/audio policy, actual media and saved scene policy are cross-checked; inspection rejects covered sidecar contradictions and digest mismatch.

The change retains owned temporary artifacts, no-clobber hardlink publication, source re-verification, and cancellation checks. New decoder/encoder children use the existing terminating Child lifetime; the first audio-origin read has the same bounded/cancellable frame-read path.

The same audio.mode is saved through revisioned demo.scene.update. Legacy drafts remain unchanged until a user edit. Dirty-state render gating and the existing operation count are retained. Schema accepts only an audio object with muted/source mode; empty nested updates merge with the existing canonical mode.

limitations: Source review plus supplied synthetic regression results; not every container, codec or timestamp pattern is exhaustively tested.
No device/AirPlay latency, native audio hardware, Pixel installation or native-speaker review was performed.
Actual Bogen updates, final whole-product qualification, packaging and installation remain root responsibilities.
